mapper.select: SELECT id, set_id, user_id, is_favorited, solved_count, solved_item_ids, last_item_id, last_active_at, created_at, updated_at FROM `problem_set_user_progress` WHERE set_id = #{setId} AND user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1
SELECT set_id FROM `problem_set_user_progress` WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_favorited = 1 ORDER BY last_active_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `problem_set_user_progress` ( set_id, user_id, is_favorited, solved_count, solved_item_ids, last_active_at ) VALUES ( #{setId}, #{userId}, 0, #{solvedCount}, #{solvedItemIds}, NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE solved_count = #{solvedCount}, solved_item_ids = #{solvedItemIds}, last_active_at = NOW()

INSERT INTO `problem_set_user_progress` ( set_id, user_id, is_favorited, solved_count, last_active_at ) VALUES ( #{setId}, #{userId}, #{isFavorited}, 0, NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE is_favorited = #{isFavorited}, last_active_at = NOW()

INSERT INTO `problem_set_user_progress` ( set_id, user_id, is_favorited, solved_count, last_item_id, last_active_at ) VALUES ( #{setId}, #{userId}, 0, 0, #{lastItemId}, NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE last_item_id = #{lastItemId}, last_active_at = NOW()
